competency_fulfillment.rationale: Every sample presents a list of numbers to arrange, e.g. seed 44 "Arrange these numbers from smallest to largest: 26, 15, 33", directly matching the ordering verb.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The vice-versa clause is honored: largest-to-smallest (seed 42, seed 600) and smallest-to-largest (seed 44, seed 502) are each generated multiple times.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Both bare number lists and short named contexts, "Maria counted seashells collected by 3 friends: 24, 32, 35", are simple, single-clause sentences.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Pure numeral lists sit alongside contextual word problems (seashells, stickers, marbles) and list lengths vary from three to five numbers.

competency_alignment.rationale: The varying element is list length and value magnitude, both on the ordering skill.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Seed 500 uses values up to 1000 ("993, 998, 996, 1000") and seed 501 uses "1000, 544, 997", reaching the competency's stated ceiling.
